videoDetails.title: Baby Hates Tummy Time? Try These Tummy Time Positions Instead!!(Tummy Time How To)
keywords: how to do tummy time with newborn
tummy time for babies when to start
videoDetails.shortDescription:
If your baby hates tummy time, you must watch this video!  This video covers 5 different tummy time positions and how you can make all 5 of these tummy time exercises for baby easier so your baby will start to enjoy tummy time. In this video you will be shown how to do tummy time with newborn and game changing tummy time tips. This video will help you make tummy time for babies enjoyable. A great tummy time how to for all new parents.

These 5 tummy time positions are great tummy time for 0 -3 month old babies and include:
- Tummy time on pillow/ Tummy time boppy
- Tummy time on chest
- Tummy time on Lap
- Football hold tummy time position
- Tummy Time on an exercise ball

Hi! I'm a Pediatric Occupational Therapist with over 12 years experience and a mum to 3 children. 

If you're a parent this channel is for you! Here you'll learn about child development, common parenting myths to avoid, and get tips and tricks to make your life as parents easier. Everything you see here is evidence based, combined with hands-on clinical experience after working with 1000's of families throughout my career. Not only will this help you be great parents but it will help your child learn important life skills and give them the best start to life.

For more parenting advice, check out our website: https://brightestbeginning.com
